Slimgal CT (Cetilistat 120 mg Capsules) is a lipase inhibitor designed to manage obesity by reducing the absorption of dietary fats. It works locally within the digestive system, preventing enzymes from breaking down triglycerides into absorbable free fatty acids. Unlike stimulant-based diet pills that act on the central nervous system, Slimgal CT focuses on the digestive process — ensuring effective fat control with minimal systemic side effects.
